notes: Accepted as an active shadow thesis-search fixture, not as a trade. theses.thesis: NVIDIA remains the liquid public proxy for frontier-compute scaling. Upside target is 250.22 by the 2026-06-18 option expiry if accelerator supply, hyperscaler AI capex, or frontier-compute scarcity reprices faster than the current option structure implies.
theses.catalyst: earnings, accelerator supply/capex guide, export-control update, or hyperscaler AI capex revision inside the June 18 options window
theses.plannedExit: first liquid mark after catalyst or thesis invalidation; otherwise close before expiry week
theses.falsifier: datacenter accelerator demand or margins decelerate, export controls bind harder than modeled, hyperscaler capex revisions weaken, or option IV/spreads absorb the edge
